mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.poll.qmc.QustnrManageMapper.selectQustnrTmplatManageList */ SELECT QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, QUSTNR_TMPLAT_TY AS qestnrTmplatTy FROM LETTNQUSTNRTMPLAT
mapper.update: /* com.portal.user.poll.qmc.QustnrManageMapper.updateQustnrManage */ UPDATE LETTNQESTNRINFO SET QUSTNR_SJ = #{qestnrSj}, QUSTNR_PURPS = #{qestnrPurps}, QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = #{qestnrTmplatId}, QUSTNR_WRITNG_GUIDANCE_CN = #{qestnrWritngGuidanceCn}, QUSTNR_BGNDE = REPLACE(#{qestnrBeginDe}, '-', ''), QUSTNR_TRGET = #{qestnrTrget}, QUSTNR_ENDDE = REPLACE(#{qestnrEndDe}, '-', ''), LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = SYSDATE(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} WHERE QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId}
mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.poll.qmc.QustnrManageMapper.selectQustnrManageDetail */ SELECT a.QESTNR_ID AS qestnrId, a.QUSTNR_SJ AS qestnrSj, a.QUSTNR_PURPS AS qestnrPurps, a.QUSTNR_WRITNG_GUIDANCE_CN AS qestnrWritngGuidanceCn, DATE_FORMAT(a.QUSTNR_BGNDE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS QESTNR_BEGIN_DE, DATE_FORMAT(a.QUSTNR_ENDDE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS QESTNR_END_DE, DATE_FORMAT(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(a.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, a.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, a.QUSTNR_TRGET AS qestnrTrget, a.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, ( SELECT t.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_TY FROM LETTNQUSTNRTMPLAT t WHERE t.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = a.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID ) AS QESTNR_TMPLAT_TY FROM LETTNQESTNRINFO a WHERE a.QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.poll.qmc.QustnrManageMapper.insertQustnrManage */ INSERT INTO LETTNQESTNRINFO ( QESTNR_ID, QUSTNR_SJ, QUSTNR_PURPS, QUSTNR_WRITNG_GUIDANCE_CN, QUSTNR_BGNDE, QUSTNR_ENDDE, QUSTNR_TRGET, QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{qestnrId}, #{qestnrSj}, #{qestnrPurps}, #{qestnrWritngGuidanceCn}, REPLACE(#{qestnrBeginDe}, '-', ''), REPLACE(#{qestnrEndDe}, '-', ''), #{qestnrTrget}, #{qestnrTmplatId}, SYSDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
